عَيْنٌ مُلْتَجَّةٌ (tropical:) An eye intensely black. (K.) ―
-b2- أَرْضٌ مُلْتَجَّةٌ (tropical:) Land intensely green, (K,) whether its herbage be tangled or not: or land of which the herbage is compact and tall and abundant. (TA.) ―
-b3- أَرْضٌ بَقْلُهَا مُلْتَجٌّ Land of which the leguminous plants are compact, or dense. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
